mapper.select: SELECT m.* FROM t_menu m INNER JOIN t_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} AND m.is_delete = 0 AND m.status = 0 ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM t_menu m INNER JOIN t_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN t_employee_role er ON rm.role_id = er.role_id WHERE er.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND m.is_delete = 0 AND m.status = 0 AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != ''
